title: TextCloak: Safeguarding Data from Unauthorized LLM Fine-Tuning via RL-Driven Unlearnable Examples
abstract: arXiv:2607.28862v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The development of Large Language Models (LLMs) has led to significant advances across a wide range of language tasks, while simultaneously raising growing concerns about unauthorized online data exploitation and privacy leakage. Unlearnable examples (UEs) emerge as a promising defense by injecting crafted perturbations into data such that models trained on them exhibit degraded utility. However, existing methods for text protection are primarily designed for classification tasks and discriminative language models, which limits their broad applicability (e.g., instruction following or reasoning) in LLMs. In this work, we propose **TextCloak**, an RL-driven data synthesis framework that safeguards textual data against unauthorized LLM fine-tuning. translated_title: TextCloak：通过强化学习驱动的不可学习样本保护数据免受未经授权的LLM微调
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）的发展在众多语言任务中取得了显著进展，同时也引发了人们对未经授权的在线数据利用和隐私泄露日益增长的担忧。不可学习样本（UEs）作为一种有前景的防御手段应运而生，其通过在数据中注入精心设计的扰动，使得在这些数据上训练的模型效用下降。然而，现有的文本保护方法主要是针对分类任务和判别式语言模型设计的，这限制了它们在LLM中的广泛适用性（例如指令遵循或推理任务）。在这项工作中，我们提出了TextCloak，这是一个由强化学习驱动的数据合成框架，用于保护文本数据免受未经授权的LLM微调。TextCloak采用一种不可学习样本生成策略，将干净文本转换为不可学习样本，同时保持语义忠实性和语言自然性。为了优化该策略，w...
tldr: TextCloak提出了一种基于强化学习的数据合成框架，通过生成既能保持语义忠实性和语言自然性又能降低模型学习效果的不可学习样本，来保护文本数据免受未经授权的大语言模型微调。
en_tdlr: TextCloak proposes an RL-driven data synthesis framework that safeguards textual data against unauthorized LLM fine-tuning by generating unlearnable examples that preserve semantic fidelity and linguistic naturalness.
